verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs explicitly claim efficient multi-LoRA support for both dense and MoE layers. The claim maps directly to the story, and vLLM's OpenAI-compatible server provides the serving path. The evidence is only a single feature-list line, though, without deeper documentation or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: detailed docs on adapter loading/switching and per-request adapter selection, limits on concurrent adapters, independent or benchmark corroboration of multi-LoRA efficiency.
